# Project Instructions

- Build a mobile-first Chinese ordering app with native HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.
- Use Vite for bundling, vite-plugin-pwa for installable offline support, and Capacitor for Android packaging.
- Keep the first screen focused on menu browsing and ordering; do not add a marketing landing page.
- Preserve accessibility, responsive layout, and localStorage persistence.
- Validate changes with a production build and browser smoke test.
